text: As at 31 December 2025, the largest shareholders of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China were Central Huijin Investment Ltd with 34.79% and the Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of China with 31.14%, each classed as 'State-owned' in ICBC's shareholder register; the National Council for Social Security Fund held a further 5.35% in aggregate.
short: China's Central Huijin (34.79%) and Ministry of Finance (31.14%) are ICBC's largest shareholders.
